name: dotted-map
title: Dotted Map
description: A dotted world map rendered as SVG, with markers, optional pulses and custom marker overlays.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the SVG. Dots use currentColor, so a text-* class recolours them.

props.name: mapSamples
props.description: Number of grid cells sampled across the map. More samples give more, closer dots.

props.name: markers
props.description: Markers to place: { lat, lng, size?, pulse? } plus any extra fields you want in renderMarkerOverlay.

props.name: markerColor
props.description: Fill of the markers and their pulse rings.

props.name: dotRadius
props.description: Radius of each land dot, in viewBox units.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Offset every other row by half a dot for a honeycomb pattern.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Pulse every marker. A marker can opt out with pulse: false (or opt in when this is off). Disabled under reduced motion.

props.name: renderMarkerOverlay
props.type: (scope: { marker, index, x, y, r }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Render prop drawn inside each marker's <g>, for labels, flags or icons. marker has the snapped x / y plus your own fields.

props.name: ...props
props.description: Any other SVG attribute (style, aria-label, …) goes to the <svg>.
